plan.title: Health-alert recovery retirement
plan.goal: Retire the qa-phase-0 health alert when a complete clean phase-0 run proves recovery, fenced against concurrent failures.
success_criteria: Clean complete phase-0 run archives the exact snapshotted alert as recovered; every other outcome leaves it pending.
Independent implementation review and activation evidence accompany release acceptance.

phases.name: Scoped recovery retirement
phases.goal: Queue fence, monitor predicate, API projection and dashboard row for one producer/key.

items.name: Generation-fenced alert retirement
items.goal: Snapshot before the probe, retire under lock on exact generation equality, project last machine recovery.
items.validation_goal: Monitor, queue, route and dashboard fixtures plus QA 86.x pass.
